name: Arcane Strike
description: Infuse your weapon with arcane energy for a powerful strike.

name: Flame Blade
description: Enchant your weapon with fire for burning strikes.

name: Frost Weapon
description: Enchant your weapon with ice that slows enemies.

name: Shock Touch
description: Electrify your attacks to chain to nearby enemies.

name: Spell Thrust
description: Thrust forward with a spell-enhanced lunge.

name: Blink Strike
description: Teleport to an enemy and strike them.

name: Arcane Shield
description: Create a magical barrier around yourself.

name: Elemental Burst
description: Release all elemental energy in an explosion.

name: Magic Missile Barrage
description: Fire a rapid burst of magic missiles.

name: Enchant Armor
description: Magically reinforce your armor.

name: Dispelling Strike
description: Strike that removes magical buffs from the target.

name: Mana Burn
description: Burn enemy mana with your attacks.

name: Combat Teleport
description: Short-range teleport that can be used in combat.

name: Force Push
description: Push enemies away with magical force.

name: War Magic
description: Enter a state where spells and attacks enhance each other.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: Imbue weapon with chosen element for duration.

name: Counterspell
description: Interrupt and counter enemy spellcasting.

name: Spellstrike
description: Combine a spell and weapon attack into one.

name: Arcane Explosion
description: Explode with arcane energy, damaging all nearby.

name: Time Stop
description: Briefly freeze time to reposition and attack.
